_comment: Single place for every outbound link AERIS Music uses. A link that is empty is omitted from the video descriptions, so the block degrades cleanly until K fills the affiliate id in.
_shopee_links_comment: Per-surface Custom Links minted 2026-11-03 from the affiliate dashboard (account navintas) with ops/shopee_mint.py. Target: a music-lifestyle product search (หูฟังบลูทูธ / Bluetooth headphones) so a viewer who taps lands on something buyable, not the generic homepage that gave 0 clicks. Each carries its surface in Sub_id1 (utm_content=youtube|tiktok|facebook, verified on the 301). Re-mint with `python3 ops/shopee_mint.py --target <url> --write`.
